import json,unicodedata
cards=[json.loads(x) for x in open('cards.jsonl')]
answers=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(cards)==len(answers)
assert [c['card_id'] for c in cards]==[a['card_id'] for a in answers]
required={'card_id','choice','anchor_heads','letter_heads','readability','ownership_ok','confidence','note','usage'}
allowed={'breathing':{'none','psili','dasia','unknown'},'accent':{'none','acute','grave','circumflex','unknown'},'diaeresis':{'none','present','unknown'},'subscript':{'none','present','unknown'}}
for c,a in zip(cards,answers):
 assert required<=a.keys()
 assert a['choice'] in {*c['options'],'literal','unreadable'}
 word=a['transcription'] if a['choice']=='literal' else c['options'].get(a['choice'],'')
 letters=[ch for ch in unicodedata.normalize('NFD',word) if unicodedata.category(ch).startswith('L')]
 assert len(a['letter_heads'])==len(letters)-1
 assert {h['index'] for h in a['letter_heads']}==set(range(len(letters)))-{c['anchor_index']}
 for h in [a['anchor_heads'],*a['letter_heads']]:
  for k,vals in allowed.items():assert h[k] in vals
 assert a['usage']=={'input_tokens':0,'output_tokens':0}
print('Verified count and order:',len(answers))
print('Literal:',sum(a['choice']=='literal' for a in answers))
print('Unreadable:',sum(a['choice']=='unreadable' for a in answers))
print('Hard cards:',', '.join(a['card_id'] for a in answers if a['confidence']!='high'))
